test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

There is no need to __panic__, not yet.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'fright'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word** "panic"** refers to sudden uncontrollable fear or anxiety, often causing wildly unthinking behavior.(भगदड़). 
 
• The correct synonym** "fright"** also refers to a sudden intense feeling of fear.(भय).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'fright'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Mock'** means to tease or laugh at in a scornful or contemptuous manner. (मजाक उड़ाना).
 
• **'Cheer' **means to give comfort or support to someone.(उत्साहित करना).
 
• **'Block' **refers to make the movement or flow in (a passage, pipe, road, etc.) difficult or impossible.(रोकना).
